note: The dated version history of every canonical policy page in apps/web/lib/legal-constants.ts. The last version of each must match the text the page publishes and the date it prints; scripts/check-policy-versions.mjs fails when either moves alone. A change that leaves the date where it is appends a version with a note saying why it is editorial. recordedSince is the day these histories began: a policy whose first version is dated after it is listed on /changelog with that version's summary. Each record in publications names a day production was checked, a commit on main that prints the dates production served then, and as main the commit carrying the replacement at that moment, main's head or the commit on a branch that moves a date, so a replaced version says whether it applied on this site or was replaced before it was published here. The workflow is in docs/compliance/README.md.

versions.summary: The date moves to 2026-10-08, the public launch day. Corrects three statements without changing your rights or obligations. The CLI is no longer described as released, and the terms say it keeps provider keys in owner-only files on Linux or when the keyring is turned off. Deleting an account still sends no confirmation email; the terms no longer say that is because the product sends no account email, which was not true. The appeal route for a suspended account is in section 04 of the acceptable use policy, not section 05. The age rule changes: you must be at least 13 to create an account, and if you are under 18 you need permission from a parent or guardian, who accepts the terms on your behalf. It used to require an account holder to be 18, with younger users only under a supervised account. Sign-up asks for your age and refuses anyone under 13; we do not verify the age or the permission, and the age is not kept. Four additions. You need our written permission to use our names and logos, and may not use them to suggest we endorse you. While a subscription payment is overdue, paid features are switched off and the account runs with the Free plan’s limits; there is no grace period, and a failed payment does not delete your content. The sanctions section now names the United States Office of Foreign Assets Control. A material change to these terms takes effect no sooner than 30 days after it is posted. Also states that on the Free plan a chat on the default model goes to a provider AGI chooses, not one you pick: Alibaba Cloud Model Studio, at its international endpoint in Singapore, or OpenRouter’s free router, depending on what is available for that turn.

versions.note: Same-day revision before release: the audit-log row reads the nightly purge time from the registered schedule, as the privacy policy does, instead of saying an administrator runs it; the deletion row and section 10 drop the false statement that the product sends only support-escalation and scheduled-task email; section 04 replaces the paragraph that called the subprocessor list incomplete and dated its review with the policy date, since the recipients it named are listed now and Apple receives nothing; the Local and BYOK rows drop the word released and add the owner-only file store. The age rule changed: section 09 no longer says accounts are for people aged 18 and over; accounts are open from the age of 13, anyone under 18 needs permission from a parent or guardian, and sign-up asks for an age that is checked in the browser, refused under 13 and not kept. It still says no age verification and no verifiable parental consent is performed, and now says that people this Act treats as children can hold accounts and that we cannot tell which accounts those are, in place of the statement that we do not knowingly collect a child's personal data. The account row says the age is asked and not kept. The date stays because the 2026-10-08 version has not shipped. versions.summary: Adds connectors you sign in to at the provider. For those, AGI stores the access token and any refresh token encrypted in your account, together with the scopes granted and a label for the connected account. When you disconnect, or your account is deleted, AGI deletes its copy and asks the provider to revoke the tokens where it can; otherwise remove AGI in that provider account settings. Connectors whose provider registration is not in place are marked Needs setup and cannot be connected.
